water_l_per_ha: Method of application For direct seeded Rice- Seeds are soaked in water for overnight and water is drained out. These water soaked seeds are stored in shade for pre-germination. Prepare total slurry volume 16 ml with appropriate quantity of the formulation and water for treating 1 kg of rice seed. Seed can be treated by mixing the proper amount of the slurry and seed on a polythene bag or appropriate seed treatment equipment until each seed is uniformly coated. The treated seeds should be dried in shade.
